reject_title_groups.reason: Role appears materially below target seniority.
Role appears centered on event execution rather than the target AI, operations, systems, or transformation direction.

operational_signals.label: Systems and operating-model ownership
operational_signals.pattern: \b(own|lead|define|build|establish|design)\w*\b[^.!?]{0,100}\b(operating model|business systems|process ownership|operational processes|process foundations|systems strategy|application ecosystem|operating rhythm)\b

operational_signals.label: Practical automation and adoption
operational_signals.pattern: \b(design|build|implement|evaluate|drive|establish|introduce|deploy|take ownership)\w*\b[^.!?]{0,220}\b(automation|AI tooling|AI tools|AI adoption|agentic workflows|workflow tooling|system adoption)\b

operational_signals.label: Strategic execution and decision support
operational_signals.pattern: \b(drive|own|track|run|build|lead)\w*\b[^.!?]{0,90}\b(workstreams|strategic initiatives|priority go.to.market initiatives|recommendation|top priorities|operating cadences?|business reviews|business planning)\b

specialist_checks.label: Tax specialization
requirement_patterns: \b(tax experience|indirect taxation|technical knowledge of sales and use tax|tax compliance|tax audits)\b
specialist_checks.question: Does your verified experience include the posting’s direct tax practice and statutory expertise, rather than only process improvement?

specialist_checks.label: Equity administration specialization
requirement_patterns: \b(equity administration|stock plan management|certified equity professional|equity compensation principles|ASC 718)\b
specialist_checks.question: Can you demonstrate direct stock-plan/equity administration expertise and any required credential?

specialist_checks.label: ML research and production-training depth
requirement_patterns: \b(background in ML engineering|background in ML research|ML training pipelines|RLHF systems|production ML ownership|years of production ML)\b
specialist_checks.question: Does the posting require prior hands-on ML/research ownership that your evidence supports? Program leadership is not a substitute.

specialist_checks.label: Silicon delivery specialization
specialist_checks.question: Do you have the explicitly requested chip-delivery or silicon lifecycle experience?

specialist_checks.label: Large-scale infrastructure specialization
requirement_patterns: \b(large.scale distributed systems|deep technical understanding of infrastructure|ML infrastructure|GPU/TPU)\b
specialist_checks.question: Verify direct large-scale infrastructure delivery and engineering depth; general technology leadership alone does not establish it.

specialist_checks.label: Specialist accounting expertise
specialist_checks.question: Does your evidence support the required accounting/treasury practice expertise?

specialist_checks.label: Hands-on software engineering ownership
specialist_checks.question: Is the primary work designing and operating production software, and does your verified engineering experience support that responsibility?

investigation_checks.label: Billing and payments domain
requirement_patterns: \b(demonstrated success in billing|working knowledge of billing systems|expertise in Order.to.Cash|understanding of usage.based billing|revenue accounting)\b
investigation_checks.question: Confirm your direct billing/payments or order-to-cash experience and whether transferable operations work is sufficient.

investigation_checks.label: Enterprise platform and leadership scope
requirement_patterns: \b(ownership of large.scale enterprise application portfolios|deep experience with one or more major enterprise platforms|5\+ years leading teams)\b
investigation_checks.question: Validate enterprise-platform portfolio ownership, required platform depth, and team-leadership scope against your actual evidence.

investigation_checks.label: Vendor/BPO workforce operations
requirement_patterns: \b(personally run onboarding|operated scaled human review programs|BPO workforces)\b
investigation_checks.question: Have you directly operated vendor/BPO reviewer onboarding, provisioning, and workforce capacity—not just overseen general programs?

investigation_checks.label: Production automation implementation
requirement_patterns: \b(scripting the glue|building with LLMs|own them in production|shipping internal AI tools)\b
investigation_checks.question: Check hands-on scripting, API integration, agent evaluation, and production support expectations against your demonstrated experience.

investigation_checks.label: Recruiting function experience
requirement_patterns: \b(part of a talent team|how recruiting operates day to day|technical recruiting|recruiting operations)\b
investigation_checks.question: Is this recruiting-centered work a direction you want, and can you demonstrate the required talent-team context?

investigation_checks.label: Regulated enterprise readiness
investigation_checks.question: Verify direct regulated-customer readiness and security/compliance delivery experience; partnering with specialists may differ from owning this work.

investigation_checks.label: Direct sales analytics and GTM systems
requirement_patterns: \b(proficiency in SQL or R|deep experience with GTM systems|experience in sales strategy)\b
investigation_checks.question: Verify direct sales-strategy analytics and GTM platform depth, and whether this commercial focus is work you want.

investigation_checks.label: Engineering/research collaboration depth
investigation_checks.question: Check the actual technical-depth bar against your evidence; coordinating engineers is different from making specialist engineering judgments.
